fields.v: Spec-first (judgement): research findings (.agents/) and phased plans with measurable success criteria are written before implementation and validated against at the end, with no sign they are maintained afterwards; authors' wording: the research phase 'enables a spec-driven development workflow where specifications become executable, directly generating working implementations'
fields.quote: This enables a spec-driven development [26] workflow where specifications become executable, directly generating working implementations.
fields.why: The author's value says 'Not classifiable' but then classifies it as spec-first, so the SDD level is internally inconsistent and must be settled one way.
fields.doubt: O valor diz 'Not classifiable' mas acaba por indicar 'spec-first'. Decide um só nível: o fluxo de 6 fases (research, plan, implement, validate) escreve planos antes do código, o que aponta para spec-first; vê §4.3.1 na pág. 5. Se preferires 'Not classifiable', retira a menção a spec-first.
